# Real Stretch 4 grasp offsets

Measured with `python -m examples.vla.molmobot_droid.franka_retarget.calculate_gripper_offset_real` from the gripper camera's view of the fingertip ArUco markers; see that script for how.
All values are mm in Stretch's TCP frame (`grasp_center_link`): x along the approach, y between the fingers, z across. The grasp offset is the Robotiq's pinch point minus Stretch's at the same jaw width, i.e. `--grasp-offset-mm`.

## 2026-10-08 19:39:56 · eoa_wrist_dw4_tool_sg4 · stretch-se4-4024

Gripper at 162 of 300 %, left gripper camera, 30 frames.

**`--grasp-offset-mm 99.2,5.8,3.0`** (default: `92,21,17`)

| | measured | URDF, same finger angles |
|---|---|---|
| left fingertip | -113.4, +58.4, -0.7 | -7.0, +82.1, +0.0 |
| right fingertip | -114.3, -69.9, -5.2 | -7.0, -82.1, +0.0 |
| Stretch pinch point | -113.9, -5.8, -3.0 | -7.0, -0.0, +0.0 |
| Robotiq pinch point | -14.7, +0.0, +0.0 | -14.7, +0.0, +0.0 |
| jaw width | 128.4 | 164.3 |
| grasp offset | +99.2, +5.8, +3.0 | -7.7, +0.0, -0.0 |
| frame-to-frame (1σ) | +0.1, +0.0, +0.1 |  |

- The jaws are wider than the Robotiq opens (128 > 87 mm); compared with it fully open.
- Markers off the URDF's: left 107.7 mm 18.4°, right 105.6 mm 20.2°
- That is more than the URDF being slightly off: check the camera side and the stickers.
- Jaw line tilted roll -2.0°, yaw +0.4° from the TCP's y (not in the offset).
